segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so for the Westbridge rollout, they confirmed 48 seats for the first wave and another 17 after payroll closes on November 15.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Good. Did they push back on the services line or are we still at $6,400 for onboarding?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Still $6,400. The only change is they want the first invoice split, 70% on signature and 30% at go-live, which finance said is fine if the term stays annual prepaid.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay, that's clean. I can update the order form language this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Thanks. Also, side note, I noticed the Northlake agreement ends on Friday and I don't think anyone's actually talked to them about carrying on yet, so that's sitting out there.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Yeah, not ideal. Anyway, for Westbridge, legal already accepted the mutual NDA reference, right?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They did. They only asked to cap the data retention period at 60 days after termination, and our template is already 45, so no issue.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Perfect. If we get signature by the 6th, customer success can still hit the December 2 go-live.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. I'll send them the clean copy once you adjust the invoice split. Nothing fancy in the pricing sheet, just 65 seats at $72 per seat monthly equivalent, billed annually.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Got it. I'll have it back to you before three.
